summary: want to feel Hang with humans not masked transactions As teacher I wear one every day not cloth but hope strings weighing heavy on bent ears. Can't shut off encompassing silence need some noise #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
want
to feel
  Hang with
humans not
  masked transactions
As teacher I
  wear one every day
not cloth but
hope
   strings weighing heavy on
bent ears.
  Can't shut off
encompassing
silence
need some
 noise
#smallpoems
